subject: Information Theory
title: How Netflix Streams
description: A quick win: understand How Netflix Streams.

hook.text: Netflix sends 17% of all internet traffic. Without compression, the internet would need 100× more bandwidth.

buildup.text: Netflix uses H.264, H.265, and AV1 codecs that compress video 1,000× compared to raw frames.

discovery.text: Most frames are similar to the previous one. Codecs encode only the differences—temporal compression.

twist.text: Netflix pre-encodes each title at dozens of quality levels. Your device picks the best one for your bandwidth.

climax.text: Adaptive bitrate streaming adjusts in real time. Bad connection? Lower quality. Good connection? Crystal clear.

quiz.question: How do video codecs achieve high compression?
options: By encoding only differences between similar frames
